title: Queen against rook

D0.outcome: Explains the queen-against-rook method: separate the rook from its king with forks, checks from a distance, and avoid stalemate traps.

D1.outcome: Given a standard position, finds the check sequence that separates the rook from the king.

D2.outcome: In unlabeled positions, wins queen against rook in the winning positions and identifies the fortress positions.

D3.outcome: Plays out against the tablebase-backed opponent within a move budget.

misconceptions: The extra queen wins by itself.
conditions: Long-range diagonal checks; keep queen and king on different lines.
contrasts: The extra queen wins by itself (some fortress positions draw).
Queen against rook with several pawns.
